summary: Full-stack VCA MVP tested. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases pass (health, auth me + 401 paths, catalog list/top/detail/404, dashboard stats, collection CRUD + soft-delete, certify + verify (found/not-found), certifications list, Slabook feed/post/like-toggle/comment, pricing tiers, shipping settings, submissions create+list, and AI scanner with a real Charizard PNG returned a valid identification/grade_values/market payload). Frontend web preview (mobile viewport, token injected via localStorage): login hero + Google button render, Dashboard shows $1,125 portfolio + quick actions + grade breakdown + top cards, Vault lists 6 seeded items with working Certify (navigates to /slab/VCA... and renders full certificate: card image, VCA 8 grade, subgrades, QR, slab/NFC ids), Scan tab renders upload/camera buttons, Slabook feed loads with composer/like/comment and the pytest-created TEST post appears, Verify shows 'Certification not found' for bogus code, Profile shows Trent Collector with edit-bio/logout, Top page shows category/grade chips. No red screens, no page errors, no broken images. Only warnings are React-Native-Web deprecations (shadow*, pointerEvents) coming from libraries, not app code.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking; likely from libraries (react-native-web/RN 0.76+). Optional cleanup: migrate shadow* to boxShadow and move pointerEvents into style objects across shared components.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Silence RN-Web deprecation warnings by migrating shadow* → boxShadow and pointerEvents prop → style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is single-file ~700 lines; still readable but approaching the split threshold — consider modularizing into routers (auth/cards/collection/certifications/social/submissions/scanner) if further features are added.
@app.on_event('startup') is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handlers.
auth_me returns full user doc including internal 'last_login' datetime — fine, but omit if any fields are sensitive.
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-existing seed (14 cards, 6 collection items for tester@vca.example, seeded posts). Tests do create/soft-delete their own TEST_ items and posts; residual TEST post + submission remain in DB (safe).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL in frontend/.env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Session token 'testtoken_abc123' is seeded for tester@vca.example (admin). To web-test, add init script to set localStorage['vca_session_token']. Scan endpoint hits Gemini via emergentintegrations; fetch card image with User-Agent header (pokemontcg.io 403s otherwise).
